الكلبه الجميله molly جاتلنا العياده و بعد الفحص اكتشفنا وجود حبوب واضحة في منطقة البطن و بعد التشخيص بال (pyoderma) بدأنا معاها protocol العلاج الصح ✅ و المناسب لحالتها
⚠️ التشخيص الصحيح مهم جدًا لأن العلاج بيختلف حسب السبب.
🐾 اهتم بجلد حيوانك الأليف… لأن صحته تبدأ من العناية
(Pyoderma)
What does it mean ?
Pyoderma is a bacterial skin infection in dogs that causes redness, itching, bumps, pustules, and crusting.
And the most common causes of (pyoderma) are
• Allergies
• Bacterial or fungal infections
• Parasites
• Environmental irritation
• Excessive licking or scratching
This cutie molly came into our clinic and after further examination we discovered redness and bumps all over her abdomen which caused her great discomfort and after the proper diagnosis we were able to start the right protocol for her condition✅
⚠️ Proper diagnosis is important because the treatment depends on the underlying cause.
🐾 Don’t ignore skin changes — healthy skin means a happier pet!
